name: ASP.NET Core
summary: Microsoft's C# framework for web apps and APIs, running on Windows, Mac or Linux.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs on Windows, Linux or macOS, in Docker, behind Nginx or IIS, or on Azure.

has_server_code.note: Pages and endpoints run on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Pages are Razor Pages rendered on the server, not React components.

setup.step: Create the app with dotnet new webapp and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Settings live in appsettings.json; never put passwords there. Use the Secret Manager in development and environment variables in production, which override the file.
In environment variable names, a double underscore stands for a nested key: ConnectionStrings__Default sets ConnectionStrings:Default.
